## Learning Objectives

By the end of this week you should be able to:

1. Compose two shallow networks and describe the resulting function.
2. Write a deep network in general matrix notation with weights and biases per layer.
3. Explain why the number of linear regions grows exponentially with depth.
4. Compare depth and width at a fixed parameter budget.
5. Implement a configurable-depth MLP in PyTorch.
